additional_info.subject: ID0460609-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002564] Charger Unavailable CRM:00263000138
additional_info.body:
Dear
Maria Borrelli
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
MP / R9 170002564
which led to the opened ticket:
0460609
.
Problem description:
"On our system, charger n. 170002564 it is online and it is charging regularly (last charge on Nov8th) but on Sifinity we see: CSMS: connected - Status: Unavailable - both connectors: faulted."
We have attempted a reboot to see if it would resolve the issue, but unfortunately, the problem persists. As a next step, we will send the ticket to the experts and open a ticket with the Sifinity team to investigate why the status is showing as "Unavailable."
We will keep you updated on any progress. Thank you!
With best regards,
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547, Corroios, Portugal
